# 1 - Set paths and root directory, load packages

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  tidycensus,
  mapcdatakeys,
  janitor,
  readxl,
  rjson,
  stringr,
  data.table,
  here,
  arrow
)

# Set ACS / PUMS vintage
vintage <-  2023

# Date tag for output files
prod.date <- Sys.Date()

# Set MAPC at 101 or 97 towns
# reb <- 'MAPC101'
reb <- 'MAPC97'

if (grepl('VM',Sys.info()[['nodename']])){
  base <- '//data-sync/Public/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
} else {
  base <- 'S:/Network Shares/K Drive/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
}

root <- paste0(base,'Projections/Projections_2028/Data/01_Regional_Control_Totals/')

rwt.path <- paste0(root, 'Reweighter/LRTP_2028/')
mapcm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'MAPCM/')
swm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'SWM/')

emp_path <- paste0(root, 'Employment/')
urb.path <- paste0(root,'UrbanSim_base_pop/')
raw.path <- paste0(urb.path,'ma_state_base_data_2010_2020_v20261005/')


if (reb == 'MAPC97') {
  input_path <- paste0(swm.path, 'Output_Files/')
  output_path <- paste0(root, 'Control_Total_Files/SWM/')
} else {
  input_path <- paste0(mapcm.path, 'Output_Files/')
  output_path <- paste0(root, 'Control_Total_Files/MAPCM/')
}


#MAPC/UrbanSim Subregion Crosswalk File.
subregion_xwalk <- fread(paste0(root,'subregions_crosswalk.csv'))

mpos <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> pull(mpo) |> unique()

ms <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> select(muni_id, mpo, rpa_acr)

blks20 <- mapcdatakeys::geog_xw_2020 |> 
  select(bl20_id,muni_id) |> 
  left_join(ms, by='muni_id') |> 
  mutate(block_id=as.character(bl20_id))

## turn off scientific notation
options(scipen = 999)
#Set random seed
set.seed(351)
# Helper function
sun <- function(x){sort(unique(x))}
lun <- function(x){length(unique(x))}

#Set knitr path
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rwt.path)

```

# 2 - SWM
## 2a - Base Year Control Totals

```{r}

input_path <- paste0(swm.path, 'Output_Files/')
output_path <- paste0(root, 'Control_Total_Files/SWM/')

yr <- 2020

dt <- fread(paste0(
  urb.path,
  'UrbanSim_2020_baseyear_micropop_with_PUMS_vars.csv'
)) |>
  mutate(block_id = as.character(block_id), new_WGTP = 1) |>
  left_join(blks20, by = 'block_id') |>
  filter(SPORDER == 1) |>
  left_join(subregion_xwalk, by = c('mpo' = 'RPA')) |>
  rename(subregion_code = subregion_code_urbansim) |>
  mutate(
    year = yr,
    US_AGEHHDER = case_when(
      AGEP < 15 ~ 0,
      AGEP >= 15 & AGEP <= 35 ~ 1,
      AGEP >= 36 & AGEP <= 45 ~ 2,
      AGEP >= 46 & AGEP <= 65 ~ 3,
      AGEP >= 66 & AGEP <= 75 ~ 4,
      AGEP >= 76 ~ 5
    ),
    US_HINC = case_when(
      HINCP2013 <= 35000 ~ "1",
      HINCP2013 > 35000 & HINCP2013 <= 75000 ~ "2",
      HINCP2013 > 75000 & HINCP2013 <= 125000 ~ "3",
      HINCP2013 > 125000 & HINCP2013 <= 225000 ~ "4",
      HINCP2013 > 225000 ~ "5"
    ),
    HHSize = case_when(persons == 1 ~ 1, persons == 2 ~ 2, persons == 3 ~ 3, persons >= 4 ~ 4),
    age_of_head_min = case_when(
      US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 15,
      US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 35,
      US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 45,
      US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 65,
      US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ 75
    ),
    age_of_head_max = case_when(
      US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 35,
      US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 45,
      US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 65,
      US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 75,
      US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ -1
    ),
    income_min = case_when(
      US_HINC == 1 ~ 0,
      US_HINC == 2 ~ 35000,
      US_HINC == 3 ~ 75000,
      US_HINC == 4 ~ 125000,
      US_HINC == 5 ~ 225000
    ),
    income_max = case_when(
      US_HINC == 1 ~ 35000,
      US_HINC == 2 ~ 75000,
      US_HINC == 3 ~ 125000,
      US_HINC == 4 ~ 225000,
      US_HINC == 5 ~ -1
    ),
    persons_min = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, HHSize == 2 ~ 2, HHSize == 3 ~ 3, HHSize == 4 ~ 4),
    persons_max = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, HHSize == 2 ~ 2, HHSize == 3 ~ 3, HHSize == 4 ~ -1),
    children_min = case_when(children == 0 | persons == 1 ~ 0, children > 0 &
                               persons > 1 ~ 1),
    children_max = case_when(children == 0 | persons == 1 ~ 0, children > 0 &
                               persons > 1 ~ -1)
  )

full_segment_set <- dt |>
  select(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
  ) |>
  unique() |>
  group_by(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
  ) |>
  mutate(segment_id = cur_group_id()) |>
  setDT()
setorder(full_segment_set,segment_id)

base.ctrl <- dt |>
  group_by(
    subregion_code,
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
  ) |>
  summarize(total_number_of_households = round(sum(new_WGTP))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
  ) |>
  mutate(segment_id = cur_group_id()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  setDT()


dt.expand <- data.table()

for (i in unique(base.ctrl$subregion_code)){
  
  df <- left_join(
    full_segment_set,
    base.ctrl[subregion_code == i],
    by = c(
      'segment_id',
      'age_of_head_min',
      'age_of_head_max',
      'income_min',
      'income_max',
      'persons_min',
      'persons_max',
      'children_min',
      'children_max'
    )
  ) |> 
    mutate(
      subregion_code = i,
      total_number_of_households = case_when(
        is.na(total_number_of_households) ~ 0, 
        .default = total_number_of_households)
    )
  
  dt.expand <- rbind(dt.expand, df)
  rm(df)
}


setnames(dt.expand,
         'total_number_of_households',
         paste0('total_number_of_households', yr))

fwrite(dt.expand,
       paste0(
         output_path,
         'urbansim_2020baseyear_control_totals_all_segments_SWM.csv'
       ))


```

## 2b - Projection Year Control Totals
```{r}

ctrl.wide <- fread(paste0(output_path,'urbansim_2020baseyear_control_totals_all_segments_SWM.csv'))

for (yr in seq(2025, 2050, 5)) {
      
    dt <- fread(paste0(
        input_path,
        'reweighted_PUMS_',
        reb,
        '_',
        yr,
        '_hh_adj_final.csv'
      )) |>
      filter(SPORDER == 1) |>
      left_join(subregion_xwalk, by = c('mpo' = 'RPA')) |>
      rename(subregion_code = subregion_code_urbansim) |>
      mutate(
        US_AGEHHDER = case_when(
          AGEP < 15 ~ 0,
          AGEP >= 15 & AGEP <= 35 ~ 1,
          AGEP >= 36 & AGEP <= 45 ~ 2,
          AGEP >= 46 & AGEP <= 65 ~ 3,
          AGEP >= 66 & AGEP <= 75 ~ 4,
          AGEP >= 76 ~ 5
        ),
        US_HINC = case_when(
          HINCP2013 <= 35000 ~ "1",
          HINCP2013 > 35000 & HINCP2013 <= 75000 ~ "2",
          HINCP2013 > 75000 & HINCP2013 <= 125000 ~ "3",
          HINCP2013 > 125000 & HINCP2013 <= 225000 ~ "4",
          HINCP2013 > 225000 ~ "5"
        ),
        HHSize = case_when(persons == 1 ~ 1,
                           persons == 2 ~ 2, 
                           persons == 3 ~ 3, 
                           persons >= 4 ~ 4),
        age_of_head_min = case_when(
          US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 15,
          US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 35,
          US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 45,
          US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 65,
          US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ 75
        ),
        age_of_head_max = case_when(
          US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 35,
          US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 45,
          US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 65,
          US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 75,
          US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ -1
        ),
        income_min = case_when(
          US_HINC == 1 ~ 0,
          US_HINC == 2 ~ 35000,
          US_HINC == 3 ~ 75000,
          US_HINC == 4 ~ 125000,
          US_HINC == 5 ~ 225000
        ),
        income_max = case_when(
          US_HINC == 1 ~ 35000,
          US_HINC == 2 ~ 75000,
          US_HINC == 3 ~ 125000,
          US_HINC == 4 ~ 225000,
          US_HINC == 5 ~ -1
        ),
        persons_min = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, 
                                HHSize == 2 ~ 2, 
                                HHSize == 3 ~ 3, 
                                HHSize == 4 ~ 4),
        persons_max = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, 
                                HHSize == 2 ~ 2, 
                                HHSize == 3 ~ 3, 
                                HHSize == 4 ~ -1),
        children_min = case_when(children == 0 | persons == 1 ~ 0,
                                 children > 0 & persons > 1 ~ 1),
        children_max = case_when(children == 0 | persons == 1 ~ 0,
                                 children > 0 & persons > 1 ~ -1)
      ) |>
      group_by(
        subregion_code,
        age_of_head_min,
        age_of_head_max,
        income_min,
        income_max,
        persons_min,
        persons_max,
        children_min,
        children_max
      ) |>
      summarize(total_number_of_households = round(sum(new_WGTP))) |>
      ungroup() |>
      group_by(
        age_of_head_min,
        age_of_head_max,
        income_min,
        income_max,
        persons_min,
        persons_max,
        children_min,
        children_max
      ) |>
      mutate(segment_id = cur_group_id()) |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      setDT()
  
    ctrl.wide <- left_join(
      ctrl.wide,
      dt,
      by = c(
        'segment_id',
        'subregion_code',
        'age_of_head_min',
        'age_of_head_max',
        'income_min',
        'income_max',
        'persons_min',
        'persons_max',
        'children_min',
        'children_max'
      )
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      total_number_of_households = case_when(
        is.na(total_number_of_households) ~ 0, 
        .default = total_number_of_households)
    ) |> 
      setDT()
  
    setnames(ctrl.wide, 'total_number_of_households', paste0('total_number_of_households', yr))
 
}

fwrite(ctrl.wide, paste0(output_path, 'SWM_control_totals_5yr_wide_', prod.date, '.csv'))

subregion_zerobase_nonzeroproj <- ctrl.wide[total_number_of_households2020 == 0 &
            (
              total_number_of_households2025 > 0 |
                total_number_of_households2030 > 0 |
                total_number_of_households2035 > 0 |

            )]
fwrite(subregion_zerobase_nonzeroproj, paste0(output_path, 'SWM_subregion_segments_zeroHH_baseyear_nonzeroHH_projyears_',prod.date,'.csv'))

ctrl.long <- pivot_longer(ctrl.wide, c(paste0('total_number_of_households',seq(2020,2050,5)))) |> 
  mutate(year = as.numeric(str_sub(name,-4,-1))) |> 
  rename(total_number_of_households = value) |> 
  select(-name) |> 
  relocate(year,subregion_code,segment_id,total_number_of_households) |> 
  setDT()

fwrite(ctrl.long, paste0(output_path, 'SWM_control_totals_5yr_long_', prod.date, '.csv'))

sk <- arrow::open_dataset("K:/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/Projections/Projections_2023/Data/03_UrbanSim/Skims/TDM23/tdm23.3.0/2024_skims_20260915/swm_skims_2024_skims_20260915/Parquet/swm_skims_2024_skims_20260915.parquet") |> 
  collect() |> 
  setDT()

```

## 2c - Interpolate to Annual Totals

```{r}

input_path <- paste0(swm.path, 'Output_Files/')
output_path <- paste0(root, 'Control_Total_Files/SWM/')

reb <- 'MAPC97'

swm.expand <- ctrl.long %>%
  select(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max,
    year,
    subregion_code
  ) |>
  group_by(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max,
    subregion_code
  ) |>
  tidyr::complete(year = tidyr::full_seq(2020:2050, 1)) %>%
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(
    ctrl.long,
    by = c(
      'age_of_head_min',
      'age_of_head_max',
      'income_min',
      'income_max',
      'persons_min',
      'persons_max',
      'children_min',
      'children_max',
      'year',
      'subregion_code'
    )
  ) |>
  setorder(
    year,
    subregion_code,
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
  ) |> 
  group_by(
    subregion_code,
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
    ) %>%
  mutate(total_number_of_households = round(zoo::na.approx(total_number_of_households, na.rm = FALSE))) %>% 
  ungroup() |> 
  select(-segment_id) |> 
  relocate(year,subregion_code,total_number_of_households) |> 
  setDT()


swm.expand[is.na(total_number_of_households), total_number_of_households:=0]

fwrite(swm.expand, paste0(output_path,'SWM_Annual_Household_Control_Totals_',reb,'_LRTP2028_',
      prod.date,'.csv'))

```

## 3b - Projection Year Control Totals
```{r}
# MAPC model with 101

if (reb == 'MAPC101') {
  
  mapc.ctrl.pp <- data.table()
  
  for (yr in seq(2020, 2050, 5)) {
    if(yr==2020){
      fl <- fread(paste0(
        urb.path,
        'UrbanSim_2020_baseyear_micropop_with_PUMS_vars.csv'
      )) |> 
        mutate(block_id = as.character(block_id)) |> 
        left_join(blks20, by='block_id') |> 
        filter(rpa_acr == 'MAPC')
    } else {
      fl <- fread(paste0(
        output_path,
        '/reweighted_PUMS_',
        reb,
        '_',
        yr,
        '_hh_adj_final.csv'
      ))
    }
    dt <- fl |>
      filter(SPORDER == 1) |>
      mutate(
        US_AGEHHDER = case_when(
          AGEP < 15 ~ 0,
          AGEP >= 15 & AGEP <= 35 ~ 1,
          AGEP >= 36 & AGEP <= 45 ~ 2,
          AGEP >= 46 & AGEP <= 65 ~ 3,
          AGEP >= 66 & AGEP <= 75 ~ 4,
          AGEP >= 76 ~ 5
        ),
        US_HINC = case_when(
          HINCP2013 <= 35000 ~ "1",
          HINCP2013 > 35000 & HINCP2013 <= 75000 ~ "2",
          HINCP2013 > 75000 & HINCP2013 <= 125000 ~ "3",
          HINCP2013 > 125000 & HINCP2013 <= 225000 ~ "4",
          HINCP2013 > 225000 ~ "5"
        ),
        HHSize = case_when(NP == 1 ~ 1, NP == 2 ~ 2, NP == 3 ~ 3, NP >= 4 ~ 4),
        age_of_head_min = case_when(
          US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 15,
          US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 35,
          US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 45,
          US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 65,
          US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ 75
        ),
        age_of_head_max = case_when(
          US_AGEHHDER == 1 ~ 35,
          US_AGEHHDER == 2 ~ 45,
          US_AGEHHDER == 3 ~ 65,
          US_AGEHHDER == 4 ~ 75,
          US_AGEHHDER == 5 ~ -1
        ),
        income_min = case_when(
          US_HINC == 1 ~ 0,
          US_HINC == 2 ~ 35000,
          US_HINC == 3 ~ 75000,
          US_HINC == 4 ~ 125000,
          US_HINC == 5 ~ 225000
        ),
        income_max = case_when(
          US_HINC == 1 ~ 35000,
          US_HINC == 2 ~ 75000,
          US_HINC == 3 ~ 125000,
          US_HINC == 4 ~ 225000,
          US_HINC == 5 ~ -1
        ),
        persons_min = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, 
                                HHSize == 2 ~ 2, 
                                HHSize == 3 ~ 3, 
                                HHSize == 4 ~ 4),
        persons_max = case_when(HHSize == 1 ~ 1, 
                                HHSize == 2 ~ 2, 
                                HHSize == 3 ~ 3, 
                                HHSize == 4 ~ -1),
        children_min = case_when(children == 0 | persons == 1 ~ 0,
                                 children > 0 & persons > 1 ~ 1),
        children_max = case_when(children == 0 | persons == 1 ~ 0,
                                 children > 0 & persons > 1 ~ -1)
      ) |>
      group_by(
        year,
        age_of_head_min,
        age_of_head_max,
        income_min,
        income_max,
        persons_min,
        persons_max,
        children_min,
        children_max
      ) |>
      summarize(total_number_of_households = round(sum(new_WGTP))) |>
      ungroup() |>
      group_by(
        age_of_head_min,
        age_of_head_max,
        income_min,
        income_max,
        persons_min,
        persons_max,
        children_min,
        children_max
      ) |>
      mutate(segment_id = cur_group_id()) |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      relocate(total_number_of_households, .before = age_of_head_min) |> 
      relocate(segment_id, .after = year) |>
      setDT()
    
    if (yr == 2020) {
      fwrite(dt,
             paste0(
               output_path,
               'urbsim_baseyear_control_total_groups_',
               reb,
               '.csv'
             ))
    }
    if (yr > 2020) {
      fwrite(dt,
             paste0(
               output_path,
               'swm_control_totals_',
               reb,
               '_',
               yr,
               '.csv'
             ))
    }
    swm.ctrl.pp <- rbind(swm.ctrl.pp, dt)
    rm(dt)
    gc()
    message(paste0('SWM Control Totals ', yr, ' Complete'))
  }
  
  fwrite(
    mapc.ctrl.pp,
    paste0(
      output_path,
      'mapcm_5yr_control_totals_',
      reb,
      '_LRTP2028_',
      prod.date,
      '.csv'
    )
  )
  
}


```

```{r}
  group_by(
    age_of_head_min,
    age_of_head_max,
    income_min,
    income_max,
    persons_min,
    persons_max,
    children_min,
    children_max
    ) %>%
  mutate(total_number_of_households = round(zoo::na.approx(total_number_of_households, na.rm = FALSE))) %>% 
  ungroup() |> 
  setDT()


mapc.expand[is.na(total_number_of_households), total_number_of_households:=0]

fwrite(mapc.expand, paste0(output_path,'MAPCM_Annual_Household_Control_Totals_',reb,'_LRTP2028_',
      prod.date,'.csv'))


```
